LanguageData.WFL_Military_VanguardBonus: Breaker: closes fast and breaks the enemy's line, going for their shooters. Moves 20% faster while closing on an enemy and hits 10% harder once engaged. Weakness: Harder to dodge with: dodge falls 15% while charging.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_GuardianBonus: Anchor: holds the line and covers wounded and downed friends. Takes 15% less damage while covering an ally. Weakness: Moves 8% slower and kills no faster than anyone.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_DuelistBonus: Skirmisher: wins a one-on-one and picks off an enemy who has strayed from the pack. Hits 15% better and dodges 20% better with one enemy near. Weakness: Dodge falls 15% once three or more are close.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_MarksmanBonus: Precision: steady, accurate fire at the middle distance on whoever is exposed. 10% more accurate between 12 and 30 cells; prefers exposed and armed targets. Weakness: 10% less accurate inside 6 cells.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_GunnerBonus: Suppression: volume of fire that keeps the enemy's heads down at short range. Weapon cooldown 15% shorter (fires more often) and 5% more accurate within 12 cells; prefers the nearest enemy. Weakness: 8% less accurate beyond 20 cells.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_SniperBonus: Overwatch: patient long-range kills on the enemy's most dangerous. 15% more accurate beyond 25 cells once set up (not moving); prefers the most dangerous target. Weakness: 25% slower to aim, and 15% less accurate inside 10 cells.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_FieldMedicBonus: Medic: keeps the line standing, tending the fallen where they lie. Needs a Community Care Doctor qualification as well as Soldier or Ranger. Tends 15% faster with a friend down within 6 cells. Weakness: fights worse, 10% less accurate and 10% worse at landing a melee blow.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_OfficerBonus: Commander: coordinates the line and steadies those near. Soldiers within 10 cells of them shoot and strike 5% better in a fight (it does not stack). Weakness: directs rather than fights, 8% less accurate and 8% worse at dodging.
